A ray diagram showing a single ray of light passing through a triangular glass prism. The ray strikes the left face at angle $i$ to the dashed normal line, bends towards the normal inside the glass, and hits the right face. It emerges, bending away from the normal at angle $e$. Dotted lines extend the initial incident ray forward and the final emergent ray backward to show the angle of deviation $D$ where they cross. The top angle of the prism is labelled $A$. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
